title: 振動工学
subtitle: Vibration Engineering
teachers:
AKASAKA Takeshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Structural vibration behavior should be well investigated in the process of aircraft structural design. For example, to design a wing structure, it is necessary to clarify its vibration behaviors such as its response to a gust load and its bending-torsional flutter property. In this course, students will learn the basics of vibration engineering necessary to treat practical problems on structural vibration in aircrafts.
advice:
In order to understand the nature of structural vibration, students will learn how to express the motions of various vibration systems in mathematical equations, how to solve the equations, and how to examine the meanings of the obtained solutions. Students are required not only to study actively during the class but also to work hard on exams and assignments.

In this course, we will cover the following materials:
1. Basic knowledge of vibration in mechanical systems
     Types of vibration, Harmonic vibration, Synthesis of vibration
2. Response of single degree of freedom systems to initial excitation
     Undamped or damped systems, viscous damping, coulomb damping
3. Response of single degree of freedom systems to harmonic excitation
     Response to harmonic force or harmonic displacement excitation, Vibration isolation
4. Response of single degree of freedom systems to nonperiodic excitation
     Impulse response, Inditial response
5. Vibration measurement and control
     Vibration measurement, seismic system
books: Vibration Engineering, Third edition (in Japanese), Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd.
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of Industrial Mechanics and Mechanical Mechanics.
Basic knowledge of industrial mechanics, including equilibrium (balance) of forces and the equation of motion for an accelerated object.

activityGoals.body: Be able to create an analysis model for the structural vibration
Be able to derive equations of motion based on the analysis model and solve them
Be able to explain the resonance phenomenon
Be able to explain the effect of the damping on responses to both initial excitation and harmonic excitation
Be able to analyze the simple vibration problems and capture the nature of the phenomenon

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Derive and solve the equation of motion (differential equation) for a single degree of freedom vibration system under harmonic excitation as well as the initial excitation with or without the damping effect
(2) Evaluate the vibration behavior of the system
(3) Explain exactly the resonance phenomenon
(4) Explain exactly the effect of the damping on the responses to both the initial excitation and harmonic excitation
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Solve the equation of motion (differential equations) for a single degree of freedom vibration system under harmonic excitation with or without the damping effect
(2) Evaluate the vibration behavior of the system
(3) Explain the resonance phenomenon
(4) Explain the effect of the damping on the response to harmonic excitation
